			<font style="text-indent:0pt;margin-left:0pt; padding-right:23pt;"><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;">ITEM 1.</font></font><font style="text-indent:0pt;margin-left:0pt; padding-right:4pt;text-align:left"><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;"></font><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;">BUSINES</font><a name="ITEM1BUSINESS_443918"></a><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;">S</font></font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;">Overview</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">DigitalGlobe is a leading global provider of high-resolution Earth-imagery products and services sourced from our own advanced satellite constellation and third-party providers. Our imagery solutions support a wide variety of users in defense and intelligence, civil agencies, mapping and analysis, environmental monitoring, oil and gas exploration, infrastructure management, Internet portals, and navigation technology. Each day users depend on us to better understand our changing planet in order to save lives, resources and time.</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">We were originally incorporated as EarthWatch on September&nbsp;30, 1993 under the laws of the State of Colorado and reincorporated in the State of Delaware on August&nbsp;21, 1995. On August&nbsp;22, 2002, we changed our name to DigitalGlobe,&nbsp;Inc. Our common stock has been listed on the New York Stock Exchange (&#x201C;NYSE&#x201D;) and traded under the symbol &#x201C;DGI&#x201D; since our initial public offering in May&nbsp;2009.</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">On January&nbsp;31, 2013, we completed our acquisition of 100% of the outstanding stock of GeoEye,&nbsp;Inc. (&#x201C;GeoEye&#x201D;), a leading provider of geospatial intelligence solutions. Our acquisition of GeoEye broadened our service offerings, enabled us to optimize our satellite orbits and collection of imagery, strengthened our production and analytics capabilities, increased the scale of our existing operations and diversified our customer and product mix. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;">Business Strategy</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Our long-term business strategy is to grow our core satellite imagery products and services, driving free cash flow growth and improving shareowner returns. Our strategy has evolved to include investment for growth in our multisource analytics platform business, which enables a wide array of customers to extract insight from our imagery. Additionally, our services business will help our strategic customers harness the power of our imagery and platform services to address key missions at scale. The key factors we believe will enable us to achieve our long-term business strategy include: </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">Imagery leadership. </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">We plan to efficiently deliver the highest quality imagery, while replenishing our satellite constellation in a manner that reduces capital intensity. We expect to extend our lead as the industry-best source of imagery. As a result, we expect to protect and grow our key markets with the U.S. Government and our Diversified Commercial customers through a relentless focus on quality and ease of use, driving free cash flow growth and returns by solving our customers&#x2019; problems.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">Platform leadership. </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">We are investing to build the leading multisource analytics platform to easily unlock the power of our content. Our Platform business is built on the largest historical archi</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">ve of the highest quality Earth </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">imagery commercially available. We expect to execute with our existing customers, as well as open a path to new customers and partners, while enhancing our platform&#x2019;s large scale data analytics applications and ease of use. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">Services leadership. </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">With our services business, we plan to establish our imagery and platform as an essential component of our strategic customers&#x2019; workflows. We will leverage our relationship with the U.S. Government and other key accounts to drive innovation that uniquely impacts our customers&#x2019; missions, leading to new contracts and retention of existing customers.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">Industry leadership. </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">We plan to build a brand that communicates our value and leadership through sustained proactive engagement with shareowners, customers, and influencers. We believe DigitalGlobe will become the globally recognized source of the most complete image-based information about our changing planet. We intend to build a global brand that reinforces trust with existing customers and welcomes collaboration with partners and new customers.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;"></font></p></div><div style="margin-left:10.2941176470588%;margin-right:10.2941176470588%;">
		<p><font size="1"> </font></p><div style="width:100%">

		<p style="margin:24pt 0pt 0pt;text-align:center;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">

			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">3</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"></font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"></font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"></font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"></font>

		</p>

</div></div><div style="margin-left:10.2941176470588%;margin-right:10.2941176470588%;"><hr align="center" style='background-color:#000000; border-width:0; color:#000000; height:2pt; lineheight:0; width:100%;'></hr><p style="page-break-after:always">&nbsp;</p></div><div style="margin-left:10.2941176470588%;margin-right:10.2941176470588%;"><div style="width:100%">

</div></div><div style="margin-left:10.2941176470588%;margin-right:10.2941176470588%;"><p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;"><font style="display:inline;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">Culture of leadership. </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">We believe the investments in our team and our leaders will enable us to build industry-leading businesses in imagery, platform and services, with a culture grounded in our purpose, vision and values. Our purpose is Seeing a Better World&#x2122; through which we give our customers the power to see the Earth clearly and in new ways, which enables them to make the world a better place. We are relentlessly committed to helping our customers save lives, resources and time and our vision is to become the indispensable source of information about our changing planet by 2020.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;">Bu</font><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;">siness Organization</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">We have one reportable segment</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">, in which we use common infrastructure and technology to collect, process and distribute imagery products and services </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">to customers around the world.</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font><font style="display:inline;color:#000000;font-size:10pt;">The Company measures performance based on consolidated operating results and achievement of individual performance goals.</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> We sell our products and services through a combination of direct and indirect channels, consisting of a global network of resellers, strategic partners, direct enterprise sales an</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">d web services to our U.S. Government and Diversified Commercial customer groups. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;">Products and Services</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">We offer </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Earth-</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">imagery products comprised of imagery from our constellatio</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">n of high-resolution satellites and</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> provide geospatial </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">products</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> and </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">s</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">ervices in </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">which we combine our E</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">arth imagery, analytic expertise and innovative technology to deliver integrated solutions. We process our imagery to varying levels according to our customers&#x2019; specifications and deliver our products using the distribution method that best suits our customers&#x2019; needs. Customers can purchase images that are archived in our ImageLibrary, place custom orders to task our satellites for a specific area of interest, or as a bundle of imaging and data for a region or type of location, such as cities, ports, harbors or airports.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">Imagery</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">We provide many customer-ready imagery products that are designed to enable customers to understand and analyze specific geographies of interest. This includes the Global Basemap product suite, which allows customers to access various imagery products that meet their specific needs. For example, these products can focus on imagery refresh that provides customers with fresh imagery over specific areas of interest, allowing them to extract new points of interest as they appear throughout time, or can also provide a visually appealing mosaic across specific geographies for our Location-based services (&#x201C;LBS&#x201D;) customers.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Customers specify how they want the i</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">magery content to be produced. </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Types of images collected are as follows:</font>

			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<div style="width:100%"><table style="width:100%;" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0"><tr><td style="width:18pt;"><p style="width:18pt;font-size:0pt;"></p></td><td valign="top" align="left" style="width: 17.00pt; display: inline;">
			<p style="punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;margin:0pt;">
				<font style="margin:0pt;font-family:Symbol;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-size:10pt;;"> &#xB7;</font>
			</p>
		</td><td style="width:1pt;"><p style="width:1pt;width:1pt;font-size:0pt;"></p></td><td align="left" valign="top">
			<p style="punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;margin:0pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Standard imagery &#x2013; includes radiometric and geometric correction. Radiometric correction enables images to appear uniformly illuminated with the appropriate level of brightness. Geometric correction allows a user to identify the latitudinal, longitudinal and altitudinal location of any point in an image.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<div style="width:100%"><table style="width:100%;" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0"><tr><td style="width:18pt;"><p style="width:18pt;font-size:0pt;"></p></td><td valign="top" align="left" style="width: 17.00pt; display: inline;">
			<p style="punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;margin:0pt;">
				<font style="margin:0pt;font-family:Symbol;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-size:10pt;;"> &#xB7;</font>
			</p>
		</td><td style="width:1pt;"><p style="width:1pt;width:1pt;font-size:0pt;"></p></td><td align="left" valign="top">
			<p style="punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;margin:0pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Ortho-rectified imagery &#x2013; includes radiometric, geometric and topographic correction. Topographic correction accounts for terrai</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">n and projects images onto the E</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">arth as they would be seen by the human eye. </font></p></td></tr></table></div>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<div style="width:100%"><table style="width:100%;" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0"><tr><td style="width:18pt;"><p style="width:18pt;font-size:0pt;"></p></td><td valign="top" align="left" style="width: 17.00pt; display: inline;">
			<p style="punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;margin:0pt;">
				<font style="margin:0pt;font-family:Symbol;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-size:10pt;;"> &#xB7;</font>
			</p>
		</td><td style="width:1pt;"><p style="width:1pt;width:1pt;font-size:0pt;"></p></td><td align="left" valign="top">
			<p style="punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;margin:0pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Mosaic imagery &#x2013; </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">merges multiple imagery scenes, collected at different times and dates, into a single seamless imagery product.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<div style="width:100%"><table style="width:100%;" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0"><tr><td style="width:18pt;"><p style="width:18pt;font-size:0pt;"></p></td><td valign="top" align="left" style="width: 17.00pt; display: inline;">
			<p style="punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;margin:0pt;">
				<font style="margin:0pt;font-family:Symbol;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-size:10pt;;"> &#xB7;</font>
			</p>
		</td><td style="width:1pt;"><p style="width:1pt;width:1pt;font-size:0pt;"></p></td><td align="left" valign="top">
			<p style="punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;margin:0pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Stereo imagery &#x2013; consist</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">s</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;color:#000000;"> of two images collected from two different viewpoints along the satellite orbit track that are produced as basic products, but can be viewed in stereo (&#x201C;3D</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">&#x201D;) using specialized software. </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Stereo imagery products are used for the creation of digital elevation maps, for the more accurate creation of 3D maps and flight simulations.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">In addition to offering many customer-ready products and services, certain of our customers through our Direct Access Program (&#x201C;DAP&#x201D;) </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">are able to directly task and receive imagery from our satellites within local and regional geographic boundaries of interest. We </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">sell these customers facilities, enabling</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> them to download and process imagery directly from our satellites. The DAP is designed to meet the enhanced information and operational security needs of a select number of defense and intelligence customers and certain commercial customers. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">Platform Products </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">In the current environment, the geospatial industry suffers from an imbalance between the proliferation of data from an expanding variety of sources, and users&#x2019; capacity to distill this data down to actionable information. Our platform products are closing this gap by assembling content and large-scale analytical tools in a single environment. This unlocks new use cases outside of traditional geospatial applications, allowing imagery analytics to be a standard part of planning for new business domains. These products include our Geospatial Big Data platform, which utilizes our industry-leading archive of high-resolution, best-in-class accuracy imagery to create new applications and insights. It also includes our Spatial on Demand platform that serves as a source-agnostic imagery provider for our energy customers, organizing large amounts of imagery and other geospatial datasets in a simple format for customers to use.&nbsp; </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">Services</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Customers are increasingly looking for analytic solutions to derive insights from imagery. With our services products, we use our geospatial and military intelligence expertise to deliver insight to our customers through the creation of analytic applications, on our Geospatial Big Data platform and outside of it, to create customer-specific solutions, including such products as geospatial risk intelligence reports. These products and services combine imagery with other sources of geospatial data (e.g., geotagged social media data) to deliver integrated intelligence solutions. We provide analytic solutions that accurately document change and enable geospatial modeling and analysis that predict where events will occur to help our customers protect lives, make resource allocation decisions and save time. We primarily support U.S. Government customers currently, but many of our capabilities also support intelligence requirements from international governments, global development organizations and commercial customers.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;"></font></p></div><div style="margin-left:10.2941176470588%;margin-right:10.2941176470588%;">

</div></div><div style="margin-left:10.2941176470588%;margin-right:10.2941176470588%;"><p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;"><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">Product Delivery</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">We offer a range of on- and off-line distribution options designed to enable customers to easily access and integrate our imagery into their business operations and applications, including desktop software applications and web services that provide for direct on-li</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">ne access to our ImageLibrary. </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">For example, through our </font><font style="display:inline;color:#000000;font-size:10pt;">Global Enhanced GEOINT Delivery (&#x201C;Global EGD&#x201D;),</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Global Basemap and </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Spat</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">ial On Demand </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">services, we provide hosted on-line access to our imagery for both commercial and government customers. Other distribution options </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">primarily </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">include File Transfer Protocol (&#x201C;FTP&#x201D;) and physical media, such as hard drives.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;">U.S. Government</font><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;"> Customers</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">U.S. Government revenue is sourced from multiple U.S. Government agencies, primarily focused on defense and intelligence, with th</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">e United States National Geospatial Intelligence Agency (&#x201C;NGA&#x201D;) as our largest customer. </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">The NGA serves as the primary U.S. Government procurement agency for geospatial information and purchases imagery products and services on behalf of various agencies within the U.S. Government, including defense, intelligence</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> and law enforcement agencies. The U.S. Government, inclusive of the NGA, provided 63.7%, 60.4%, and 58.4% of our revenue for the years ended December 31, 2015, 2014, and 2013, respectively.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">EnhancedView Service Level Agreement</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">On August&nbsp;6, 2010, DigitalGlobe e</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">ntered into the EnhancedView c</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">ontract with the NGA</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> (the &#x201C;EnhancedView Contract&#x201D;)</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">. The EnhancedView Contract has a ten-year term, inclusive of nine one-year renewal options exercisable by the NGA, and is subject to Congressional appropriations and the right of the NGA to terminate or suspend the contract at any time.</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> &nbsp; &nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">The EnhancedView </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Contract contains multiple deliverables, including a Service Level Agreement, (the &#x201C;EnhancedView SLA&#x201D;) that </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">totals $2.8 billion over the term of the contract, of which $250.0 million was paid per year ($20.8 million monthly) for the first four contract years commencing on September&nbsp;1, 2010, and $300.0 million is payable per year ($25.0 million monthly) for the remaining six years of the contract b</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">eginning on September&nbsp;1, 2014. </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">T</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">he NGA exercised its renewal option for year six under the EnhancedView </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">SLA through August&nbsp;31, 201</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">6</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">. We believe it is the NGA&#x2019;s intention to exercise the remaining options, subject to annual appropriation of funding and the federal budget process, which </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">contain</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> an inherent level of uncertainty in the current budget environment.</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> The EnhancedView SLA represented 48.0%, 38.9%, and 37.1% of our revenue for the years ended December 31, 2015, 2014 and 2013, respectively.</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Each monthly EnhancedView SLA payment is subject to a performance penalty of up to 4% depending upon the Company&#x2019;s performance against pre-defined performance criteria. A performance penalty is assessed in any month the NGA determines that not all of the performance criteria were met. The Company retains the full monthly cash payment; however, the penalty amount is applied to mutually agreed future products and services or to a pro-rated extension of the EnhancedView SLA beyond the current contract period.</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> We have not incurred a penalty since the year ended December 31, 2012.</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Cumulative penalties over the life of the EnhancedView </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">SLA</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> total</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> $0.4 million, or 0.03</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">%, of our total cash receipts under the contract, all of which </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">were</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> applied to other products.</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">EnhancedView Value</font><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">-</font><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">Added and Other Services</font>
		</p>

		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">The EnhancedView Contract also provides up to $750.0 million for value added products and services</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">, &nbsp;</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">infrastructure enhancements, and other services, including the option for the NGA to require the Company to lower the altitude of WorldView-2 from its current altitude of 770 kilometers to an altitude of 496 kilometers. Value</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">-</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">added products and services enable us to meet the NGA&#x2019;s more advanced imagery requirements using our production and dissemination capabilities</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">, including Global EGD which, among other things, provides for the delivery of certain orthorectified imagery and imagery-related products and services. In September 2015, the NGA executed a contract for an additional year of the Global EGD program. </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">In 201</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">5, we recognized $65.3</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> million in revenue for value-added products an</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">d services and have recognized $259.5</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> million cumulatively since the inception of the EnhancedView Contract.</font>

</div></div><div style="margin-left:10.2941176470588%;margin-right:10.2941176470588%;"><p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;"><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">NextView</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">In connection with our NextView agreement with the NGA, which was entered into in September&nbsp;2003 and was the predecessor to </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">the</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> current EnhancedView Contract, we received $266.0&nbsp;million to offset the construction costs of WorldView-1, which was recorded as deferred revenue when received. When WorldView-1 reached full operational capability (&#x201C;FOC&#x201D;) in November&nbsp;2007, we began recognizing the deferred revenue on a straight-line basis over the estimated useful life of WorldView-1</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Based on the estimated useful life of WorldView-1, we recognized </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">$15.1 million, </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">$22.9 million</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> and $25.5 million</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> of revenue related to the pre-FOC payments</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> for the </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">year</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">s ended December 31, 2015, 2014 and 2013, respectively.</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> Cumulatively, since WorldView-1 rea</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">ched FOC, we have recognized $192.3</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> million of pre-FOC revenue, and at December&nbsp;31, 201</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">5</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> had deferred revenue remaining of $</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">73.7</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> million, expected to be amortized through the fourth quarter of 2020. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;">Diversified Commercial</font><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;"> Customers</font>

			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Diversified Commercial includes customers in the </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">DAP</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">, &nbsp;</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">international civil government, </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">LBS</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">, energy</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">, &nbsp;</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">other</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> international defense and intelligence, and other</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> industry verticals.</font>

		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>

		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">We earn revenue from sales of DAP facilities, service fees to access our satellite constellation, as well as other imagery and information product sales. As of December&nbsp;31, 201</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">5</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">, we had DAP agre</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">ements in ten countries. For the years ended December 31, 2015, 2014, and 2013, DAP revenue represented 17.2%, 17.0% and 16.5% of our total revenue for each respective year.</font>
		</p>

		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Other diversified commercial revenue is generated from customers in international civil government, LBS, energy, other international defense and intelligence, and other industry verticals. We sell imagery and provide services to international civil governments for use in applications such as infrastructure planning, taxation, rescue and recovery services, forestry and agriculture. Our LBS customers rely on us to create and enhance the maps and geospatial services that billions of people use every day. We sell imagery and platform services to energy customers to enable efficient discovery, security, production and development of energy resources. Our other international defense and intelligence customers include ten foreign friendly nations, many in volatile parts of the world, who rely on us to keep their nations safe. Customers in other industry verticals</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> use our content for mapping, monitoring, analysis and planning activities.</font>

			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">8</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"></font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"></font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"></font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"></font>

</div></div><div style="margin-left:10.2941176470588%;margin-right:10.2941176470588%;"><hr align="center" style='background-color:#000000; border-width:0; color:#000000; height:2pt; lineheight:0; width:100%;'></hr><p style="page-break-after:always">&nbsp;</p></div><div style="margin-left:10.2941176470588%;margin-right:10.2941176470588%;"><div style="width:100%">

			<a href="#Toc"><font style="display:inline;color:#0563C1;font-size:10pt;">Table of Contents</font></a><font style="display:inline;color:#0563C1;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>

		</p>

</div></div><div style="margin-left:10.2941176470588%;margin-right:10.2941176470588%;"><p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;"><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">Ground Terminals and Image Processing Facilities</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">As of December&nbsp;31, 201</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">5</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">, we owned or </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">had service agreements for </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">remote ground terminals </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">in 8 locations </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">throughout the world. Each ground terminal is strategically placed to optimize contact with our sat</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">ellites on their orbital paths.</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> Eac</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">h of our satellites orbits the E</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">arth approximately 15 times per day, communicating with one or more of our ground terminals. Our image processing facility </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">in</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> Longmont, Colorado houses the hardware and software systems and personnel required to operate and control our satellites as well as process, store and distribute our imagery.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;">Competition</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;color:#000000;font-size:10pt;">There are significant barriers to entry in the geospatial industry, primarily related to the substantial costs involved with satellite construction, along with the amount of time required to build and develop ground systems and obtain necessary licenses. </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Our major existing and potential competitors for our Imagery business include commercial satellite imagery companies, state-owned imagery providers, aerial imagery companies, free sources of imagery, and unmanned aerial vehicles.&nbsp; </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">The data intensive nature of high resolution imagery, complexity of analysis, and desire to analyze multiple data sources have driven growth in multisource analytics platforms. We are uniquely positioned to provide a platform solution because of the size and quality of our industry-leading archive and our years of experience and resulting intellectual property in creating image analysis algorithms and tools. Our Platform products face competition from aggregators of imagery and imagery-related products and services. We also provide our customers with insights from our imagery with our Intelligence Services products. Our Services products face competition from companies that provide geospatial analytic information and services to the U.S. Government, including defense primes.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;line-height:6pt;text-indent: -18pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">We compete on the basis of the technical capabilities of our satellites, such as size of collection area, collection speed, revisit time, resolution, accuracy and spectral diversity; satellite availability for tasked orders; the size, comprehensiveness and relevance of our ImageLibrary; distribution platform and tools that enable customers to easily access and integrate imagery; value-added services, including advanced imagery production and analysis; timeliness and ready availability of imagery products and services that can be deployed quickly and cost-effectively; and price.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;">Regulation</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">Operations</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">The satellite operations portion of our business is highly regulated. The Department of Commerce (&#x201C;DoC&#x201D;), pursuant to the National and Commercial Space Programs Act of 2010 (successor legislation to the 1992 Land Remote Sensing Policy Act, as amended), has the primary regulatory authority over our industry. The DoC delegated responsibility for satellite remote sensing operations to </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (&#x201C;</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">NOAA</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&#x201D;)</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">. Each of our satellites is required to be individually licensed for operation by NOAA. We currently have licenses for all in-orbit satellites (&#x201C;NOAA licenses&#x201D;). Our NOAA licenses require us to obtain prior approval from NOAA for any significant and substantial foreign agreements, and generally require us to operate our satellite system in a manner that is consistent with U.S. national security and foreign policy objectives. In addition, the NOAA licenses allow the U.S. Government to suspend our imaging activities in certain cases, if deemed necessary, for national security reasons. The NOAA licenses are valid for the operational life of the satellites, provided that we comply with the licensing terms.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">The launch of our satellites and the communication links, both uplink and downlink, are regulated by the U.S. Federal Communications Commission (&#x201C;FCC&#x201D;). FCC licenses must be obtained for each individual satellite. The FCC is the governmental agency with primary authority in the United States over the commercial use of the satellite frequency spectrum. We currently have the requisite licensing authority from the FCC to operate all in-orbit satellites. The FCC has also granted licenses to operate ground terminals for our satellites. The FCC&#x2019;s rules&nbsp;and regulations and terms of our licenses require that we comply with various operating conditions and requirements. Failure to comply with these or other conditions or requirements could lead to sanctions, up to and including revocation, cancellation or non-renewal of our licenses. In addition to the FCC&#x2019;s requirements, our satellites must undergo the frequency coordination and registration process of the International Telecommunications Union (&#x201C;ITU&#x201D;), as well as a variety of other federal and international regulations.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;"></font></p></div><div style="margin-left:10.2941176470588%;margin-right:10.2941176470588%;">
		<p><font size="1"> </font></p><div style="width:100%">

		<p style="margin:24pt 0pt 0pt;text-align:center;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">

			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">9</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"></font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"></font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"></font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"></font>

		</p>

</div></div><div style="margin-left:10.2941176470588%;margin-right:10.2941176470588%;"><hr align="center" style='background-color:#000000; border-width:0; color:#000000; height:2pt; lineheight:0; width:100%;'></hr><p style="page-break-after:always">&nbsp;</p></div><div style="margin-left:10.2941176470588%;margin-right:10.2941176470588%;"><div style="width:100%">

		<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 30pt;background-color: #FFFFFF;color:#0563C1;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">

			<a href="#Toc"><font style="display:inline;color:#0563C1;font-size:10pt;">Table of Contents</font></a><font style="display:inline;color:#0563C1;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>

		</p>

</div></div><div style="margin-left:10.2941176470588%;margin-right:10.2941176470588%;"><p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;"><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">Sales</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Satellite imagery does not require an export license in order to be sold internationally. Our ability to sell certain imagery products and value added services may be subject to sanctions or embargoes imposed by the U.S. Government against particular entities or individuals, against other countries or by foreign government regulation.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Direct access to the satellites under the DAP constitute</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">s</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> significant and substantial foreign agreements under our NOAA license</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">s</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> and require</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">s</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> approval from NOAA under the terms of our NOAA license</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">s</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">. In addition, we or our suppliers must obtain export licenses from the Department of State (&#x201C;DoS&#x201D;) for the export of certain equipment and related technology necessary to enable the DAP access. The ground terminal equipment and related technology necessary to allow access to the satellites are controlled under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (&#x201C;ITAR&#x201D;). The approval process for these sales usually takes approximately two to three months, and there is no obligation on the part of either NOAA or the DoS to approve any transaction. In addition to required U.S. Government approvals, the export of equipment from Canada by our DAP equipment supplier, MacDonald Dettwiler&nbsp;&amp; Associated Ltd., is subject to Canadian export license requirements. Our DAP customers may also be required to obtain additional approvals from the government of the country in which the ground terminal is to be operated.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">Ownership</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">We are obligated under our NOAA licenses to monitor and report increases in foreign ownership of common stock of the Company and any agreement for ownership of 20% or greater of our common stock is subject to NOAA approval. We are also required to report certain common stock foreign ownership levels to the Defense Security Service and to comply with certain rules&nbsp;and regulations to mitigate foreign influence as part of maintaining our facility security clearances. Our facility security clearance allows us to perform work on U.S. Government classified contracts. A transfer to foreign ownership also could trigger other requirements including filings with, and review by, the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States pursuant to the Exon-Florio provision. Depending on the country of origin and identity of foreign owners, other restrictions and requirements may also arise.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">Environmental</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Our operations are regulated under various federal, state, local and international laws governing the environment, including laws governing the discharge of pollutants into the soil, air and water, the management and disposal of hazardous substances and wastes, and the cleanup of contaminated sites. We have infrastructures in place to ensure that our operations are in compliance with all applicable environmental regulations. We do not believe that the costs of compliance with these laws and regulations will have a material adverse effect on our capital expenditures, operating results or competitive position. The imposition of more stringent standards or requirements under environmental laws or regulations or a determination that we are responsible for the release of hazardous substances at our sites could result in expenditures in excess of amounts currently estimated to be required for such matters. While no material exposures have been identified to date that we are aware of, there can be no assurance that additional environmental matters will not arise in the future, or that costs will not be incurred with respect to sites as to which no problem is currently known.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">

Trade names and trademarks of other companies used in this annual report are for informational purposes only. </div></div><div style="margin-left:10.2941176470588%;margin-right:10.2941176470588%;"><p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;"><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;">Business Seasonality</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">

			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">We have historically experienced higher revenues in the </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">fourth quarter of the year </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">due in part to the procurement cycles of U.S. and international governments as well as increased dem</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">and from commercial customers. </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">However, historical seasonal patterns should not be considered a reliable indicator of our future revenues or financial performance.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">

		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;">Risks</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Our business is subject to many risks. The occurrence of any of the following risks could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, prospects, results of operations and cash flows. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem to be immaterial may also materially adversely affect our business, prospects, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;">Risks Related t</font><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;">o Our Business</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">The loss or reduction in scope of any one of our primary contracts will materially reduce our revenue. The majority of our revenue is currently derived from a single contract with a U.S. Government agency that can be terminated at any time.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">We generated 63.7</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">% of o</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">ur revenue from the U.S. Government and 48.0</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">% from the EnhancedView SLA in 2015. Our contracts with U.S. Government agencies are subject to risks of termination or reduction in scope due to changes in U.S. Government policies, priorities or funding level commitments to various agencies. Under the EnhancedView SLA, we are obligated to make a portion of the image tasking capacity of the WorldView constellation available to the NGA, including specified priority access rights. Beginning September&nbsp;1, 2013, the NGA has the option to require us to lower the altitude of WorldView-2 from its current altitude of 770 kilometers to an altitude of 496 kilometers, subject to receipt of all required regulatory approvals. The lowering of the orbital altitude could result in a decrease in the amount of square kilometers collected by WorldView-2. While we believe the decrease in collection capability would be offset by improved data capture capabilities on the ground, there can be no assurance that our current collection capability will be maintained. Our ability to service other customers could be negatively impacted if we are unable to maintain our current collection capacity. In addition, any inability on our part to meet the performance requirements of the EnhancedView Contract could result in a breach of our contract with the NGA. A breach of our contract with the NGA or reduction in service to our other customers could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">The NGA may also terminate or suspend our contracts, including the EnhancedView Contract, at any time with or without cause. If the EnhancedView Contract was terminated</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> early</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">, recognition of revenue currently classified as deferred would be ac</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">celerated.&nbsp;&nbsp;If the contract was</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> extended, the time period over which certain deferred revenue balances are curre</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">ntly expected to be recognized c</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">ould be extended, resulting in lower revenue recognit</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">ion than currently anticipated.</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> Additionally, any changes in the size, scope or term of the EnhancedView Contract could impact our satellite replenishment strategy and our ability to repay or refinance our long-term debt. Although our NGA contracts generally involve fixed annual minimum commitments, such commitments are subject to annual Congressional appropriations and the federal budget process, and as a result, the NGA may not continue to fund these contracts at current or anticipated levels. In addition, the sequestration process under the Budget Control Act of 2011 (PL 112-25) could have an adverse impact on the timing and amount of appropriations available for defense programs, including EnhancedView. Under the terms of the Budget Control Act, discretionary spending is capped, and any breach of the caps would result in automatic, across-the-board spending cuts, known as sequestration. The Budget Control Act assumed that spending cap recommendations would be recommended to Congress by the Joint Select Committee on Deficit Reduction. This Committee failed to come to agreement, and accordingly sequestration was implemented during 2014. Sequestration did not have a material effect on our financial position or results of operations during 2014. However, future reductions in the current EnhancedView program or other current or future business with the Department of Defense resulting from sequestration could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.</font>
		</p>

</div></div><div style="margin-left:10.2941176470588%;margin-right:10.2941176470588%;"><p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;"><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">Any program delays </font><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">in required </font><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">support</font><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;"> of</font><font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;"> the EnhancedView Contract, may affect our ability to meet our obligations under the EnhancedView Contract resulting in a reduction of scope or termination of the contract, and may otherwise require us to increase our reliance on our existing satellites to meet our business needs, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations. </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">The manufacturing, testing, launching and operation of satellites involves complex processes a</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">nd technology. We rely on third-</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">party contractors for the manufacturing, testing, </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">and launch</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> of our satellites, as well as solutions for any anomalies encountered while in orbit. Many factors, including, but not limited to, availability of parts, subcontractor and supplier delays and anomalies discovered in orbit, may result in significant challenges to our business. For example, during orbit, satellites may experience technical difficulties communicating with the ground terminals or collecting imagery in the same quality or volume that was intended. The failure to mitigate any technical difficulties could affect our ability to meet our obligations under the EnhancedView Contract and may otherwise limit the anticipated volume of imagery products and services available to meet our business needs, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">In addition, the EnhancedView Contract obligates us to meet certain capacity and timeliness of delivery requirements. To meet these requirements, we have expanded our network of ground terminals around the world</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">.</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> Our ground terminals are vulnerable to damage or interruption from human error, intentional bad acts, earthquakes, hurricanes, floods, fires, war, terrorist attacks, power losses, hardware failures, systems failures, telecommunications failures and similar events. The occurrence of any of the foregoing could result in lengthy interruptions in our services and/or damage our reputation, which could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition and results of operations.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>

			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">Interruption or failure of our infrastructure could hurt our ability to effectively perform our daily operations and provide our products and services, which could damage our reputation and harm our operating results.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">The availability of our products and services depends on the continuing operation of our satellite operations infrastructure, information technology and communications systems. Any downtime, damage to or failure of our systems could result in interruptions in our service, which could reduce our revenue and profits. Our systems are vulnerable to damage or interruption from floods, fires, power loss, telecommunications failures, computer viruses, computer denial of service attacks or other attempts to harm our systems. We do not currently maintain a back-up production facility from which we can continue to collect, process and deliver imagery in the event of the loss of our primary </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">facility</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">. In the event we are unable to collect, process and deliver imagery from our </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">f</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">acility in Longmont, Colorado, our daily operations and operating results would be materially and adversely affected. In addition, our ground terminal centers are vulnerable to damage or interruption from human error, intentional bad acts, earthquakes, hurricanes, floods, fires, war, terrorist attacks, power losses, hardware failures, systems failures, telecommunications failures and similar events. The occurrence of any of the foregoing could result in lengthy interruptions in our services and/or damage our reputation, which could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition and results of operations.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">

			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">We face competition that may cause us to have to reduce our prices or to lose market share.</font>

		<p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Our products and services compete with satellite and aerial imagery and related products and services offered by a range of private and government providers. Our current or future competitors may have </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">disruptive technologies or </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">greater financial, personnel and other resources than we have. The value of our </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">imagery may also be diluted by E</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">arth imagery that is available free of charge.</font>

In addition, such governments could </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">sell or provide free of charge E</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">arth imagery from their satellites in the commercial market and thereby compete with our imagery products and services. Also, governments may at times make our imagery freely available for humanitarian purposes, which could impair our revenue growth with </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">non-governmental organizations.</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> These governments could also subsidize the development, launch and operation of imagery satellites by our current or future competitors.</font>

</div></div><div style="margin-left:10.2941176470588%;margin-right:10.2941176470588%;"><p style="margin:0pt;punctuation-wrap:hanging;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;"><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">Our competitors or potential competitors could, in the future, offer satellite-based imagery or other products and services with more attractive features than our products and services. The emergence of new remote imaging technologies or the continued growth of low-cost imaging satellites, could negatively affect our marketing efforts. More importantly, if competitors develop and launch satellites or other imagery content sources with more advanced capabilities and technologies than ours, or offer services at lower prices than ours, our business and results of operations could be harmed. Due to competitive pricing pressures, new product introductions by us or our competitors or other factors, the selling price of our products and services may further decrease. If we are unable to offset decreases in our average selling prices by increasing our sales volumes or by adjusting our product mix, our revenue and operating margins may decline and our financial position may be harmed.</font>

			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">We are dependent on resellers of our imagery for a portion of our revenue. If these resellers fail to market or sell our products and services successfully, our business would be harmed.</font>

We rely on foreign resellers and partners to market and sell the majority of our products and services in the international market. We have intensified our efforts to further develop our operations in overseas markets, however, our foreign resellers and partners may not have the skill or experience to develop regional commercial markets for our imagery products and services, or may have competing interests that negatively affect their sales</font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;"> of our products and services. </font><font style="display:inline;font-size:10pt;">If we fail to enter into reseller agreements on a timely basis or if our resellers and partners fail to market and sell our imagery products and services successfully, these failures could negatively impact our business, financial condition and results of operations.</font>

			<font style="display:inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;">We rely on a single vendor or a limited number of vendors to provide certain key products or services to us and the inability of these key vendors to meet our needs could have a material adverse effect on our business.</font>
		</p>
